The step per call is a2 * 0.125 clamped to a maximum of 0.05; this[2] is decremented toward v2 when above it and incremented when below, never overshooting the target. Case 5 and case 7 compute phase-dependent targets from dbl_8AFEA0, flt_8ACF90, flt_8ACF94 and flt_8ACFB8 (with dword_5F0714 indexed at stride 4656 through sub_4D1B50(0) in case 7), clamped into [0.25, 1.0] or [0.5, 1.0] ranges. Invoked by sub_4C7DE0 (0x004C7DE0).

operations.description: Default target FOV v2 = 0.25 applies to session types not handled by cases 3..7 (and is the minimum clamp used elsewhere).
Dispatch on dword_7C56A4 (session type): case 3 sets v2 = 0.28, case 4 sets v2 = 0.31, case 6 sets v2 = 0.31999999, all jumping to the shared interpolation step; the default keeps v2 = 0.25.

Session-type case 5: initial v2 = 0.34; when dword_7C56A8 equals 5, compute v5 = (dbl_8AFEA0 - flt_8ACF90) / (flt_8ACF94 - flt_8ACF90), then v2 = v5 * v5 * 0.60000002 + 0.5, clamped to a minimum of 0.5.
Session-type case 5 with dword_7C56A8 equal to 8: v4 = (dbl_8AFEA0 - flt_8ACF94) * 0.0080000004, then v2 = 1.0 - v4, clamped to a minimum of 0.25.
After the case-5 computations, clamp the target upward: when v2 is greater than 1.0, v2 = 1.0.

Session-type case 7: initial v2 = 0.38; nested dispatch on dword_7C56A8 where cases 1 and 2 set v2 = 0.44, case 3 sets v2 = 0.5, case 4 computes v2 = 1.0 - (flt_8ACFB8 + 5.0 - dbl_8AFEA0) * 0.029999999 clamped to a minimum of 0.5, and the default keeps v2 = 0.38.

Session-type case 7, phase 5: v7 = sub_4D1B50(0); when dword_8ACF8C <= 1, v8 = 0.5 - 1.0, otherwise v8 = 0.5 - dword_5F0714[4656 * v7] / (dword_8ACF8C - 1); then v6 = v8 * v8 + v8 * v8 and v2 = v6 + 0.5, clamped to a minimum of 0.5.
Session-type case 7, phase 8: v4 = (dbl_8AFEA0 - flt_8ACF94) * 0.003, then v2 = 1.0 - v4, clamped to a minimum of 0.25.
Shared interpolation step: v9 = a2 * 0.125, then clamped so v9 is at most 0.050000001.
Move this[2] toward v2: when this[2] is greater than or equal to v2, subtract the step v9; when it is below, add the step v9.
Write the interpolated value back to this[2] (this+0x8), clamping so it never goes below v2 when decreasing nor above v2 when increasing.
Return void after the interpolation completes.
Invoked by sub_4C7DE0 (0x004C7DE0) as part of the camera timer/dispatch tick.

else { this[2] += v9; if (this[2] > v2) this[2] = v2; }
